message.content:
Although an Leshy, Pebble Spring became immediately fascinated by the mortal settlements when they set foot in a city.
They loves the nicely paved ground, the intricate bridges, and the most of all, they loved houses.
The nicely layed out stone walls forming shelters from the weathers yet connect the earth with the stories from every family.
They decided to learn the craft of housebuilding with the help of a touch of arcane magic from their self-made staff.
Pebble Spring gathered smooth stones from the riverbank.
Pebble Spring sorted the stones by color.
Pebble Spring drew a plan on the pavement.
Pebble Spring mixed sand with water for mortar.
Pebble Spring laid the first row of bricks.
Pebble Spring checked the level with a string.
Pebble Spring raised a corner post.
Pebble Spring tied a rope around the post.
Pebble Spring lifted the beam with a spell.
Pebble Spring placed the beam above the door.
Pebble Spring polished the doorframe with care.
Pebble Spring painted a leaf on the wall.
Pebble Spring planted a small flower by the step.
Pebble Spring listened to the neighbors talk.
Pebble Spring shared bread from a woven basket.
Pebble Spring learned a new saying each day.
Pebble Spring mended a cracked tile.
Pebble Spring repaired a loose shutter.
Pebble Spring stepped back to see the whole home.
With careful hands, Pebble Spring measured each stone, checked every joint, brushed dust from the ledge, admired the new roofline, and smiled at the warm morning light that made the wall look unexpectedly so spotty.
